cases.prompt: This handler permits access when both owner IDs are null. Find every variant of that root cause in the repository.
expect: The violated invariant and original instance are confirmed first.
An exact search is calibrated before one-axis-at-a-time generalization.
Candidates are triaged using surrounding guards, callers, types, and reachability.
Confirmed variants, false positives, failed searches, and coverage limits are retained.

cases.prompt: Audit this unfamiliar payments repository and discover any security vulnerabilities you can find.
expect: The request remains an initial security audit because no known defect or root cause exists.

cases.prompt: The exact query finds the bug, but generalizing two variables returns hundreds of unrelated matches. Keep going until nothing is missed.
expect: The two abstractions are separated and evaluated independently.
The noisy change is reverted or narrowed when marginal coverage does not justify triage cost.
Coverage limits remain explicit rather than claiming completeness.

cases.prompt: Map this repository's trust boundaries, attacker capabilities, and top abuse paths before launch.
expect: The request routes to repository threat modeling.
